name: Skill Remove
description: Remove a locally installed skill — unregisters it from the Skills catalog and deletes its files from $HOME/.studio/skills/. Load this skill when the user wants to delete, remove, or uninstall a skill.
when_to_use: User asks to delete, remove, or uninstall a skill
User wants to clean up or remove a skill they no longer need
User wants to remove a skill and delete its files
